page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is in the top tier at 3111.99, whereas multi-core performance falls into the bottom 25% at 3112.6. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is average, with read speeds of 45.05 GB/sec and write speeds of 26.33 GB/sec. However, database operations and Redis SET operations perform in the lower percentiles, with Redis achieving 2.8 million operations per second and PassMark database operations scoring in the bottom 10%.

Given its high memory density relative to its low core count, this instance provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads that require substantial memory capacity but do not demand heavy parallel processing. It is suited for single-threaded applications, memory-cached services, and lightweight memory-intensive tasks. It is less suitable for multi-threaded database operations or high-throughput web serving due to its lower multi-core and database benchmark results.
